Description.Name: Powered Repair Exoskeletons
Description.Details: [PERSISTENT] Mech parts are heavy boss, and even with cranes and ropes there's only so much we can do. Finding some industrial exoskeletons would help the crews work faster.

AssignedCastDescription: Most industrial stations have simple powered exoskeletons to help lifting heavy supplies around. Having a few in our inventory would help ammo reloading for sure.
